response.justification: Bogdan is a strong candidate due to his extensive and highly relevant experience in the geospatial domain, notably founding GISCollective, a geo-data platform. His work on low-latency, high-throughput microservices using DLang demonstrates capability in building performant systems similar to the required data pipelines. While his professional C++ experience is not recent, his deep expertise in a comparable systems language (D) and his broad technical adaptability suggest he could ramp up quickly. The combination of domain expertise and systems engineering skills makes him a compelling candidate worth exploring further.
strengths: Exceptional, hands-on experience building geospatial data platforms (GISCollective, Green Map).
Proven ability to engineer high-performance, low-latency distributed systems.
Deep expertise in DLang, a systems programming language with parallels to C++ and Rust.
concerns: Direct professional C++ experience is not recent, dating back to 2015.
Recent roles have focused primarily on TypeScript/Node.js rather than systems programming.
No explicit mention of experience with routing-specific problems like tile generation or navigation algorithms.
